title: Wire rotate_run_progress() into the assessment loop so the #332 saving actually materializes
goal: #332 added `rotate_run_progress(*, threshold_bytes, keep_bytes)` to `memory_backend.py` but never invoked it from any code path. The function is dead. The claimed ~$30/day saving from preventing `/memories/run-progress.md` from growing past 8 KB therefore does not materialize. This task wires a single call at the right place (between advances in `advance_assessment_loop`) so the rotation actually fires.
scope: Add ONE call to `memory_backend.rotate_run_progress()` inside `api/app/services/assessment_loop.py:advance_assessment_loop` immediately after the picker dispatch but before the next-advance return. Wrap in try/except (rotation is housekeeping, not gating). Add 2-3 unit tests proving (a) the call fires once per advance, (b) over-threshold file rotates, (c) under-threshold file is left alone.
generation_reason: Identified during the 10-task deferred-capability audit (DONE_LOG #326-#335). #332 task body called rotation 'safe to call repeatedly. Caller (assessment loop) can invoke between advances; out of #332 scope to wire that call.' That wire-up never landed. Operator pushback 2026-05-17: 'rotation is dead code — de geclaimde ~$30/dag besparing materialiseert NIET zonder de wire.' Filing this as the explicit follow-up.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Single call-site addition + 2-3 tests. Do NOT change rotate_run_progress() internals, do NOT change the 8192/6144 thresholds (defaults from #332 contract), do NOT touch the truncation helpers or the picker prompt.
constraints.non_gating: Rotation failure must not crash advance — wrap in try/except, log warning on failure, continue.

success_criteria: advance_assessment_loop calls memory_backend.rotate_run_progress() at most once per advance, on a stable hook point (after picker dispatch, before return).
Unit test proves the call fires on a typical advance.
Unit test proves an oversized /memories/run-progress.md is actually trimmed end-to-end after one advance (regression vector for #332 saving).
Unit test proves an under-threshold file is untouched (no spurious writes).
Rotation exception is caught + logged, never crashes the advance.

acceptance_criteria: rotate_run_progress() invoked exactly once per advance_assessment_loop call.
Over-threshold file is trimmed after one advance (proven end-to-end).
No regression in existing soft-retry / structured-output tests.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next queued item into NEXT_TASK.md.
